parameters.scalar_mult_method: GLV + fixed-base comb (w=16, 8 digits per half)

limitations: Online additions use the protected batched-affine reference; the six comb tables are built by sequential dependent additions with a standalone Fermat inversion per operation, bounded at 250,801 instructions per operation (2^39.52 instructions in total, 2^28.53 units) and charged 2^31 units.
The baby table is two m-record sort buffers (2^125.2359 bytes) plus six comb tables and a 2^64-chain online batch workspace; the huge memory is reported, not hidden.
Cheon, GLV and fixed-base comb are known methods; no novelty is claimed.
